BUILD IT AGAIN

From a brief to a shortlist.

  1. Discover. Connect TinyFish in ChatGPT and run the discovery prompt above.
  2. Verify. Open TinyFish Agent Playground, paste an official listing URL, and run the verification prompt.
  3. Compare. Keep five open U.S. summer 2027 roles. Preserve exact titles, locations, links, eligibility, and run evidence.
  4. Share. Publish the comparison and post about your build on LinkedIn, selecting TinyFish’s company mention.

This version used TinyFish browser agents through its connected app in ChatGPT. Playground is the manual reproduction path.
